recommendation.reason: Real, diverse tasks have executable tests and validated reference solutions; the best reported agent solves 42.5% of tasks.
risks: Published upstream revisions and pinned images must remain obtainable for clean-machine runs.
Reported scores lack stated repeated-run variance or confidence intervals.

release.quote:
This repository contains all 120 task definitions, the evaluation harness,
Claude Code and Codex adapters, container definitions, and the reusable portion
of the data-construction pipeline.

tasks.quote:
WideSWE is a benchmark of 120 real-world software-engineering tasks across 41
software ecosystems, requiring coordinated changes across multiple repositories
in the same ecosystem. It contains 60 bug fixes and 60 features.

verifier.full_credit: every target repository passes all required checks
verifier.quote:
Hidden tests evaluate the resulting changes; a task succeeds only when every target
repository passes all required checks.
